component: Account Hub external link event handling

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current footer click handling calls openLinkExternally for an anchor and also prevents default navigation and stops propagation. The historical 585 template used inline click handlers; those are not the newer handler style to copy. Keep an external-browser action from also navigating the setup surface. Source keyboard activation behavior was not tested, and no external link was opened.
title: Prevent internal navigation when sending a footer link to an external browser
